name: JUMP-IN
description: JUMP-IN is an all-in-one macOS application that simplifies migrating between MDM solutions, enabling migration to Microsoft Intune or between Intune tenants without data loss. It performs system compatibility checks, automatic MDM detection, backups, profile removal, Company Portal installation, tenant enrollment, and FileVault key rotation to maintain security; typical migration runs in about 15-20 minutes per device.
author: Somesh Pathak

securityCheck.aiSummary: The script performs a legitimate macOS admin task (rotating FileVault recovery keys) but handles user credentials in plaintext and writes them to a temporary plist, posing credential exposure risks. It also displays the sensitive recovery key to the user, increasing exposure risk. No remote code execution, hardcoded secrets, or exfiltration detected. Mitigations include securing credential handling (avoid plaintext storage, escape inputs), reducing on-screen exposure of the recovery key, and validating input robustly.
